messages:
emily_sales: FYI — MapleEd (K12 SaaS, 120 schools) just asked for a bespoke EDU package. They want "dedicated" infra, EU data residency, SOC2, and a 200k USD annual commit. Asking for 60% off list across hosted generation and embeddings. Can we do this?

raj_sdr: who is the champion and timeline? any POC?

emily_sales: Champion is CTO (A. Park). Wants a 6-week POC, then enterprise contract if POC passes. Timeline: pilot starts mid-May. They said price has to be within their district budget or they drop.

maria_revenue_ops: 60% sounds aggressive. Can you paste the requested rate vs list? also need to know expected qps/throughput for dedicated pool.

emily_sales: list we use for hosted generation: $0.025/token and embeddings $0.0005/vector as baseline. Their ask translates to ~ $0.01/token and $0.0002/vector. I'll ping liam for capacity numbers.

liam_engineering: For a dedicated pool for 120 schools, estimated steady qps looks like 600-800 reqs/s peak; with caching and batching could fit into a small dedicated cluster but need 48h notice to provision GPUs in eu-west-1. Also SOC2 + EU residency adds ops overhead.

noah_legal: Any special legal asks beyond SOC2 and data residency? IP, custom data use, or PSP clauses? If they want indemnities or extended warranties that's a blocker.

emily_sales: Nothing else mentioned yet, but their procurement did flag PII handling and subprocessor list.

maria_revenue_ops: Pricing options to propose: quick thoughts — 1) Pilot-first: 3-month POC at 25% off list (no dedicated pool, hosted with strict prefixes & KV caching) + success criteria to unlock committed pricing. 2) Committed tier: 2-year commit, 35-40% off year1, 25% year2 + onboarding credits. 3) Deep discount (50-60%) only if they commit 400k+ annually or take multi-year + prepay. We should avoid 60% on a 200k commit — margin goes negative with dedicated + SOC2 ops.

raj_sdr: I can push the pilot-first. CTO seems risk-averse; POC would reduce their ask.

sarah_dealdesk: Can we get a quick margin calc? we need to know max acceptable discount and any non-price concessions (support uplift fee, onboarding fee, infra surcharge). If finance signs off, deal desk can approve up to 45% off for EDU vertical with exec sponsor.

maria_revenue_ops: Quick calc (rough): list 200k run-rate revenue -> at 60% off revenue becomes 80k. Estimated infra + ops + SOC2 marginal cost ~ 45-50k/year for dedicated + support -> leaves ~30k before other costs. Not sufficient. 40% leaves 120k rev -> healthier.

emily_sales: OK — proposed counter to MapleEd: 3-month POC (hosted with enhanced privacy controls) at 25% off. If success, convert to 24-month committed contract with 40% off year1 + 20% year2, or option to prepay for 45% off. Include a $15k onboarding + security validation fee to cover SOC2/residency setup.

noah_legal: That approach is fine. We need to add standard data processing addendum and include subprocessors clause. If they want bespoke indemnities, loop legal back in.

sarah_dealdesk: Sounds reasonable. I'll draft an approval memo: max dealer discount = 45% only with prepay or 2-year lock and exec sign-off. I'll also add the onboarding fee as a non-discountable line. @emily_sales can you confirm POC success criteria and share expected token/embedding volumes so I can finalize AR terms?

emily_sales: sending details and champion contact now. I'll propose the POC and the two commercial paths. Thanks all.
